detailed_results.input: A laptop has 8 GB of total RAM. System processes consume 2.5 GB. A local model consumes 3.5 GB. How much RAM in GB remains free for other applications? State the exact final number.
detailed_results.output:
To find the remaining free RAM, we subtract the system and local process consumptions from the total available RAM:

$$ \text{Free RAM} = \text{Total RAM} - (\text{System Processes} + \text{Local Model}) $$

Substituting the given values:
$$ \text{Free RAM} = 8 \text{ GB} - (2.5 \text{ GB} + 3.5 \text{ GB}) $$
$$ \text{Free RAM} = 8 \text{ GB} - 6 \text{ GB} $$
$$ \text{Free RAM} = 2 \text{ GB} $$

The exact final number is **2**.
